reasoning: The PKGBUILD is a standard .NET build recipe that fetches a pinned source tarball from the official GitHub repository with a valid SHA-256 checksum. disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error (LLM API HTTP 400 BadRequestError) in the qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 model when attempting to audit the .SRCINFO file, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict. The deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash model successfully audited all files and found them safe. This is not a substantive security disagreement but rather a tool failure.
coverage_issues: Report from qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit .SRCINFO due to LLM API error (HTTP 400)
learnings: Tool errors (API failures) on inert metadata files like .SRCINFO should not trigger an 'inconclusive' security verdict; the tool should retry or use a fallback check
Disagreements caused by tool errors rather than substantive security findings should be automatically resolved without requiring human adjudication
